title: Ship marks ticket done before the final gate check passes
body:
What happened: in the ship prep step (shipPrepJob, machine.ts around line 575), warden checked gatesProven, then ran markTicketDone (set-status done in the ticket worktree), then re-checked the gates after that write. The re-check failed on format; warden reran the gates. The done change to the ticket file stayed uncommitted in the worktree and blocked the next step.

Expected: the ticket is marked done only after the final gate check passes, or the done change is reverted when that check fails.

Repro: a feature run whose ship prep re-check fails (formatting in a generated file). Then warden done for the implement step is refused.

Evidence: warden done refused with exact message: uncommitted changes: backlog/PG-012.md. git status in the worktree showed the backlog file as modified: status todo changed to done.
note: Accepted. Planned for a coming release.
